disambiguation: It is a full vault viewer and editor, not just a synchronization tool.
extras: Reading is free; writing requires a paid subscription.
problem: Obsidian lacks a native web application, forcing users to rely on exports that lose core functionality like Dataview and backlinks.
summary: Note Relay is a desktop plugin and browser viewer that allows users to read and edit their local Obsidian vault from any web browser without uploading the vault content.
